protocol: ONE frozen MatchAnything ELoFTR point substitution in shared-gray analytic300

extraction.setup_report_scope: reported once by FrozenMatchAnything.setup_report, not charged perpair

point_loader_metadata.mask: fixed target coordinate inside original moving rectangle; no adaptive query dropping
